messages:
morgan: publish blocked: typegen bumped SDK 4.0.0 -> 4.1.0 due to enum ordering-only change in generated types. anyone?
ci-bot: publish-job-7819 failed: changelog.semver_check failed. diff: 4.0.0 -> 4.1.0. logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/7819
elaine: repro'd locally. sample-app auth/retry flake retriggered build; freshly-built SDK produced enums in different order. nothing semantic changed in the spec.
josh: sounds like the generator is preserving input order. we should add a deterministic sort pass in typegen before diffing. i can land a small opt-in flag.
pat: short-term mitigation: pin integration tests during publish to the last released SDK tag instead of the freshly-built artifact. i'll open a pipeline MR for that.
morgan: also add a release label `publish/regen-ordering-ok` so a release lead can approve true ordering-only diffs when urgent. Document in the release playbook.
elaine: opening PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/typegen/pull/478 adds stable enum/property sort + normalized-diff output. includes unit tests.
josh: i'll open the pipeline MR to pin the sample-app step. ETA EOD.
pat: i'll add the release label and update playbook. ci-bot: artifacts preserved at s3://redwood-ci/artifacts/publish/7819.
morgan: thanks — aim to merge both PRs tomorrow morning so weekend release stays green. :thumbsup:
